title: DqTestSpecs
description: Test declarations of a Data Quality Rule. Every item becomes one TestCase per Column of the Rule's CDE once the Rule is Approved.

dqTestSpecKind.description: LIBRARY uses an existing column-level TestDefinition; SQL runs a Rule-owned query that returns the violating records.

dqTestSpec.description: One test declaration of a Data Quality Rule.

key.description: Server-issued identifier, stable within the Rule identity and never reused. Empty on a new declaration.

name.description: Display name, unique within the Rule (case-insensitive).

testDefinitionFqn.description: Fully qualified name of the column-level TestDefinition. Required for LIBRARY.

sqlExpression.description: Jinja2 SELECT template returning the violating records, using {{ table_name }} and {{ column_name }}. Required for SQL.

parameterValues.description: Values of the TestDefinition parameters (LIBRARY) or of extra template variables (SQL).

computePassedFailedRowCount.description: Compute passed and failed row counts so that percentage thresholds can be evaluated.

threshold.description: Threshold of this declaration. When empty the quality threshold of the Rule applies.

items.description: Declarations in display order. An empty list means the Rule only describes a requirement.
